releaseNotes: Installer-driven updates: in-app updates now stage and run the versioned installer after Excel exits, keeping the VSTO registration, Windows Installed Apps entry and uninstaller always correct. The staged-update gate is strict: only a strictly newer version is actionable, and stale jobs finalize themselves instead of showing 'Update ready' forever.
A post-install integrity gate now verifies product files, VSTO registration, Installed Apps metadata and updater state after every install, and repairs a stale Installed Apps version at startup.

Workbook Audit: a one-click, strictly read-only workbook health check on the Elmashad-ExcelTool tab. It finds formula errors, hardcoded interruptions and deviations inside formula patterns, external links, broken names, numbers stored as text, unexpected blanks, hidden content, merged cells, UsedRange bloat, volatile formulas and number-format deviations - with filters, a details panel, Go to Cell and an exportable report. It never modifies the workbook.
Immediate install-on-exit: the updater tracks the exact Excel process that requested the update and installs the moment it closes; Excel in other sessions never delays it.
Version authority: version.props is now the single source of truth; Help, About and Settings always display the real installed version and its release channel.
Responsive windows: Help and Settings stretch and center at any size with a true top-right close button across every Elmashad window.
New Dark theme: a lighter green-charcoal palette with high-contrast text; Light theme refined. P6 hierarchy and report colors are untouched.
